### Microphone Volume Lock v1.2.0

This release changes how the lock works under the hood, fixes the bugs that let it stop or get stuck, and gives the app a new look.

#### What's new
- **No more nircmd.** The app sets your microphone level through Windows directly. Nothing is copied to your temp folder and no helper process is left running.
- **The lock no longer stops after 24 hours.** It holds for as long as the app runs.
- **Closing the window keeps the lock on.** The app stays in the tray. Use Quit in the tray menu (or Ctrl+Q) to exit.
- **The slider is your microphone.** It changes the level right away and shows the real level, not a saved guess.
- **Only one copy runs.** Opening the app again brings the existing window forward.
- **Start with Windows works**, and starts the app hidden in the tray.
- **Unplugged microphone?** A lock waits and applies again as soon as a microphone is back.
- **New design and icon.**

#### Fixed
- "Run at Windows Startup" could not be turned on or off.
- "Stop All Nircmd Processes" left the app thinking it was still locked, so the next click did the opposite of its label.
- After closing the window, the old lock kept running in the background and Unlock could not stop it.
- The tray said "Lock Volume" while the microphone was already locked.
- Uninstalling left a startup entry pointing at a deleted file.

#### Removed
- "Stop All Nircmd Processes", which is no longer needed.
- The menu bar. Shortcuts still work: Ctrl+H hides to the tray, Ctrl+Q quits, Ctrl+S toggles Start with Windows.

#### Upgrading from v1.1.0
1. Quit the old version from its tray icon.
2. Run the installer. Your saved level and lock setting are kept.
3. On first start, leftover nircmd copies from v1.1.0 are stopped and removed, and an existing startup entry is updated.

#### Downloads
- `MicrophoneVolumeLock-amd64-installer.exe`: installer (recommended)
- `MicrophoneVolumeLock.exe`: standalone executable

Requires Windows 10 or later with the WebView2 runtime (included with Windows 11).
